chunk: description: Canonical model for fulfillment records — shipped line items, tracking numbers, carrier info, and fulfillment status. Written from ERP to e-commerce after shipment.
createdFrom: homage engagement (2026-05-19) — NetSuite fulfillments → Shopify fulfillment events (UC3)
note: "Stub — created from homage engagement. Promoted to versioned schema when confirmed fields from 2+ clients."

properties:
  fulfillmentId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical fulfillment identifier
  externalFulfillmentId:
    type: string
    description: Source-system fulfillment ID (e.g. NetSuite fulfillment record internalId)
  orderId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical order identifier this fulfillment belongs to
  externalOrderId:
    type: string
    description: Source-system order ID (e.g. NetSuite SO internalId or Shopify order ID)
  status:
    type: string
    enum: [pending, in_transit, delivered, failed, cancelled]
    description: Fulfillment status
  lineItems:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      properties:
        itemId:
          type: string
        sku:
          type: string
        quantity:
          type: integer
  trackingNumber:
    type: string
    description: Carrier tracking number
  trackingUrl:
    type: string
    description: Carrier tracking URL
  carrier:
    type: string
    description: Shipping carrier name (e.g. UPS, FedEx, USPS)
  serviceLevel:
    type: string
    description: Shipping service level (e.g. Ground, Priority, Express)
  shippedFrom:
    type: string
    description: Warehouse or location name shipped from
  fulfilledAt:
    type: string
    format: date-time
    description: ISO 8601 timestamp when fulfillment was created/shipped
